info.title: SpacePost API
info.summary: Resend-compatible email API on Amazon SES.
info.description:
The SpacePost API is a drop-in replacement for the Resend API: same paths, request fields, response shapes and error format.
To migrate, change the base URL (`RESEND_BASE_URL=https://api.spacepost.dev`, or `new Resend(key, { baseUrl })`) or swap the SDK import.
The official `resend` npm SDK works unchanged.

## Platform mode (tenants)
If you send on behalf of your own customers, create a tenant for each with `POST /tenants`. Each tenant has its own SES tenant
(isolated reputation), its own bounce/complaint guard, a pause switch and an optional daily cap. `tenant_id` (our id or your
`external_id`) is optional on `POST /emails`, `POST /emails/batch` items and `POST /domains`. An email from a tenant-owned domain
is attributed to that tenant automatically; a team-level domain may send on behalf of any tenant. Emails, domains and webhook
payloads carry `tenant_id`.

## Authentication
Send your API key as a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer sp_live_...`. Keys come in two flavours:

- `full_access` can use every endpoint.
- `sending_access` can only send emails (`POST /emails`, `POST /emails/batch`), optionally from a single domain.
  Any other endpoint answers `401 restricted_api_key`.

## Errors
Every error has the same shape: `{ "statusCode": 422, "name": "validation_error", "message": "..." }`.

## Idempotency
`POST /emails` and `POST /emails/batch` accept an `Idempotency-Key` header (1 to 256 characters, kept for 24 hours). Repeating
a request with the same key and body returns the original response. Reusing a key with a different body is a `409`.

## Rate limits
Each team may make 10 requests per second (25 on Scale). Responses carry `ratelimit-limit`, `ratelimit-remaining` and
`ratelimit-reset`; when exceeded the API answers `429 rate_limit_exceeded` with a `retry-after` header.

## Pagination
List endpoints return `{ "object": "list", "has_more": true, "data": [...] }`, newest first. Use `limit` (1 to 100, default 20)
and `after=<id>` for the next (older) page or `before=<id>` for the previous (newer) page. `after` and `before` cannot be combined.

## MCP
Every operation in this reference is also an MCP tool for AI agents, named after its `operationId` in snake_case
(`sendEmail` → `send_email`). Connect to the hosted MCP server at `https://api.spacepost.dev/mcp` (Streamable HTTP) with the
same `Authorization: Bearer sp_live_...` header (local options: https://docs.spacepost.dev/tools/mcp/). The same key
permissions, rate limits and idempotency rules apply. `x-mcp` and `x-permission` on an operation are hints for these tools.

tags.name: Emails
tags.description: Send, schedule, retrieve and cancel emails.

tags.name: Domains
tags.description: Sending domains with Easy DKIM and a custom MAIL FROM subdomain. A domain must be verified before you can send from it.

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Create and revoke API keys. The token is shown once, only a hash is stored.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Receive email events at your endpoint. Payloads are signed with Standard Webhooks (`webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`; Svix compatible).

tags.name: Audiences
tags.description: Lists of contacts that broadcasts are sent to.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Contacts inside an audience. Endpoints accept a contact id or an email address.

tags.name: Broadcasts
tags.description: Send one email to a whole audience, now or scheduled. Supports `{{{FIRST_NAME}}}`, `{{{LAST_NAME}}}` and `{{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}}` placeholders and one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058).

tags.name: Suppressions
tags.description: Addresses that are never sent to. Hard bounces and complaints are added automatically.

tags.name: Tenants
tags.description: Platform mode. Your own customers, each with isolated reputation, a pause switch and an optional daily cap. Requires a `full_access` key. `{ref}` is our id or your `external_id`.

post.description: Validates and queues one email. Each recipient counts towards your quota. Use `scheduled_at` to send later (up to 30 days ahead). Pass `tenant_id` to send on behalf of a tenant (not needed when the `from` domain belongs to one). Fails with `422` if `tenant_id` conflicts with the domain's tenant, `403 sending_paused` if the tenant is paused and `429 daily_quota_exceeded` if it reached its daily cap.

get.description: Returns sent and scheduled emails, newest first, without bodies.

post.description: Sends up to 100 emails in one call. All-or-nothing, if any email is invalid none are sent. Attachments, `scheduled_at` and a per-email `tenant_id` are supported; the paused-tenant and tenant-cap errors apply to the whole batch.

200.description: All emails were accepted, ids are in input order.

patch.description: Changes `scheduled_at` of an email that is still `scheduled`.

post.description:
Registers a domain and returns the DNS records to add (three DKIM CNAMEs, plus MX and SPF on the MAIL FROM subdomain).
Domain names are globally unique. The number of domains is limited by your plan (Free 3, Pro 10, Scale 1,000).

200.description: The domain with its DNS records.
A page of domains (without DNS records).
The domain with its DNS records.

post.description: Re-checks DNS now. Retrieve the domain afterwards to read the new `status` and per-record statuses.
The `token` is returned only in this response.

token.description: The secret key. Store it now

200.description: A page of keys. Tokens are never included.

delete.description: The key stops working immediately. The response body is an empty object.

post.description: In production the endpoint must use https and resolve to a public address.

200.description: The webhook including its signing secret.
The webhook including its signing secret.

post.description: Emails are lower-cased. An address can only appear once per audience.

parameters.name: idOrEmail
parameters.description: The contact id or its (URL-encoded) email address.

post.description: Creates a draft. The `from` address must belong to a verified domain of your team and `audience_id` to one of your audiences.

delete.description: Only drafts and broadcasts that are scheduled for the future can be deleted.

get.description:
SpacePost extension (not part of Resend). Returns a deliverability checklist: sender domain and DMARC, subject, Gmail
clipping (HTML over 102 KB), image-heavy bodies, link shorteners, spam phrases, unsubscribe link and audience quality.
`ready` is false when any check has level `error`; `POST /broadcasts/{id}/send` is then refused with `validation_error`.
Warnings never block a send.

code.description: Stable identifier of the exact message, for localizing it client-side.

params.description: Values interpolated into title and detail.

checks.title: Gmail will clip this message
checks.detail: The HTML is 140 KB; Gmail clips messages over 102 KB and hides the rest, including the unsubscribe footer.

post.description:
Queues a draft for delivery to every subscribed contact of its audience. The broadcast needs `html` or `text`.
Without `scheduled_at` it starts immediately; the status becomes `queued`, then `sending` and `sent`.
Adds the address with reason `manual`. Adding an address that is already suppressed returns the existing entry.

parameters.name: idOrEmail
parameters.description: The suppression id or the (URL-encoded) email address.

200.description: Removed. The address can receive email again.

post.description: Creates one of your customers, with its own SES tenant (isolated reputation). `external_id` must be unique within your account.

patch.description: Changes the name, `external_id` or `daily_limit` (`null` removes the cap).

delete.description: Fails with `422` while the tenant still has domains; delete those first.

post.description: Stops all sending for the tenant. Sends return `403 sending_paused`; emails already queued fail. The body is optional.

reason.description: Stored as `paused_reason`. Defaults to a generic reason.

post.description:
Resumes sending. A tenant that was paused by the reputation guard (bounce or complaint rate) can only be unpaused by a
`trusted` or `internal` team; others get `403 invalid_access` and should contact support.

SpacePost POSTs this payload to your webhook endpoint for every subscribed event. The shape is identical to Resend's.
Verify the Standard Webhooks signature headers (`webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`) against the raw body.
Respond with any 2xx status.

value.message: `subject`: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined

value.name: missing_api_key
value.message: Missing API key in the authorization header. Include `Authorization: Bearer sp_live_...`.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests (`rate_limit_exceeded`), or a daily or monthly sending quota was reached (`daily_quota_exceeded` also means a tenant's `daily_limit`).

example.name: rate_limit_exceeded
example.message: Too many requests. You can only make 10 requests per second.

name.description:
Machine-readable error name.

- `missing_api_key` (401): no bearer token.
- `invalid_api_key` (403): unknown or malformed key.
- `restricted_api_key` (401): the key is `sending_access` (or limited to another domain).
- `validation_error` (422): invalid request. Also used with 403 for plan limits and test-domain restrictions.
- `not_found` (404): the resource does not exist or belongs to another team.
- `method_not_allowed` (405)
- `invalid_idempotency_key` (400): key length outside 1 to 256.
- `concurrent_idempotent_requests` (409): the original request is still running.
- `invalid_idempotent_request` (409): the key was used with a different payload.
- `rate_limit_exceeded` (429)
- `daily_quota_exceeded` (429): the sandbox, daily limit or a tenant's `daily_limit` was reached.
- `monthly_quota_exceeded` (429): the plan's monthly limit was reached (Free plan).
- `invalid_from_address` (403): the sender domain is not verified.
- `invalid_access` (422; 403 when a team that is not trusted tries to unpause a tenant paused for its bounce or complaint rate)
- `invalid_parameter` (422)
- `sending_paused` (403): sending is paused for the team, or for the tenant named by `tenant_id`, after a bounce or complaint spike or a manual pause.
- `security_error` (451)
- `application_error` (500)
- `internal_server_error` (500)

ScheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time or natural language such as "in 1 hour" or "in 2 days". At most 30 days ahead.

Address.description: An email address, optionally with a display name: `Acme <hello@acme.com>`.

path.description: A public URL fetched at send time.

SendEmailRequest.description: Either `html` or `text` is required. `reply_to` is also accepted as `replyTo` and `scheduled_at` as `scheduledAt`.

tenant_id.description: Platform mode. Our tenant id or your `external_id`. Optional when the `from` domain belongs to a tenant; a conflict with the domain's tenant is a 422.
The tenant this email was sent for

name.description: Domain or subdomain you own. Lower-cased.

region.description: Accepted for compatibility. The region is chosen by the platform and returned on the domain.

custom_return_path.description: Subdomain used for the custom MAIL FROM (bounce handling and SPF).

tenant_id.description: Platform mode. Make the domain tenant-owned (our tenant id or your `external_id`). Mail from it is attributed to that tenant.
The tenant that owns the domain

recommended_records.description: Optional records that improve deliverability, such as DMARC.

domain_id.description: Restrict a `sending_access` key to one of your domains. Not allowed with `full_access`.

WebhookEventType.description: Event names you can subscribe a webhook to.

endpoint.description: Public URL that receives POST requests. https is required in production.

signing_secret.description: Used to verify the webhook signature.

external_id.description: Your own id for the customer. Unique per account; accepted wherever a tenant id is.

daily_limit.description: Max recipients per day for this tenant. Omit or null for no cap.

paused_reason.description: Why the tenant is paused (manual or reputation guard). Null when active.

WebhookEmailData.description: Fields present in `data` for every event.

created_at.description: When the email was created (the event time is the envelope's `created_at`).

tenant_id.description: Present when the email belongs to a tenant.

tags.description: The email's tags as an object of name to value. Absent when the email has none.

WebhookEvent.description:
The JSON body SpacePost POSTs to a webhook, identical to Resend's. Discriminated by `type`.
`data` always has the `WebhookEmailData` fields plus the event-specific object listed below.

UpdateBroadcastRequest.description: Any field of the create request; only drafts can be updated.

detail.description: Human-readable cause, e.g. "Hard bounce (NoEmail)" or "3 soft bounces in 30 days (MailboxFull)".
